svg.aria-label: Frozen fine-tuned pi0.5 controls the LIBERO rollout; a separately trained failure detector reads pi0.5 internal latents at every VLA call and raises a failure alert before the rollout fails.
svg.text: 1 VLA call = 10 env steps; latent extracted at every call
π0.5 internal hidden states, one per VLA call
Detector input: either latent, or both concatenated
